summary.zh: 解析招标需求并起草有实证支撑的应答
summary.en: Parse RFP requirements and draft proof-backed answers

description.zh: 收到 RFP、RFI、RFQ 或安全问卷后，区分必答项与加权评分项，按要点起草附有实证材料的应答，并估算中标概率。适合投标截止前的集中写作。
description.en: When an RFP, RFI, RFQ or security questionnaire arrives, it separates mandatory from weighted requirements, drafts answers backed by proof points and estimates win probability. Useful near a deadline.
